id.description: Immutable canonical UUID for this time-bounded market assumption.

schema_version.description: Version of the JSON Schema contract used to validate this record; it changes only through documented repository migrations.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when this repository record was first created; this is audit metadata, not the real-world entity's founding or start date.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time of the latest repository record change; it must be updated whenever a structured value or its provenance changes.

source_ids.description: Non-empty set of Source Document IDs that directly support the observed, estimated, or derived values in this record.

confidence_score.description: Evidence-strength score from 1 (unverified or speculative) to 5 (verified SEC filing), assigned under ASSUMPTIONS.md.

status.description: Current lifecycle classification for the represented entity or record; unknown is used when available evidence does not establish a state.

notes.description: Optional analyst clarification about scope, ambiguity, estimation, or lifecycle context; null means no clarification is recorded and notes never replace structured provenance.

name.description: Human-readable label that distinguishes the assumption across scenarios and periods.

assumption_type.description: Allowed analytical classification of the market variable represented.

value.description: Observed, estimated, or derived numeric assumption interpreted using unit, methodology, effective dates, and scenario.

unit.description: Explicit measurement unit for value, such as USD/MWh, USD/MW-month, USD/MW, or decimal fraction.

effective_date.description: ISO 8601 date from which the assumption applies.

end_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date through which the assumption applies; null for an open-ended or point-in-time assumption.

scenario.description: Stable scenario label, such as base, downside, or upside, under which the assumption is intended for use.

company_id.description: Optional UUID of the Company to which the assumption is scoped; foreign key to Company.id and null for market-wide assumptions.

geography.description: Optional market, balancing area, country, or region scope; null when the assumption is not geography-specific.

methodology.description: Optional explanation of estimation or derivation method, transformation version, and input record IDs; null only for directly observed values requiring no transformation.
